summary: Rebuilds a filtered array of 24-byte entries reachable from two linked node lists. Frees the previous array (24-byte stride elements with a 4-byte count header), allocates a new array sized to this+0x13C via the allocation wrapper, then walks a first node list from this+0x100 (forward link at +0x104) and a second list from this+0x108. For each node it descends a sub-chain at +0xEC and skips the node unless the sub-chain yields a node whose flags at +0x14 include 0x4000; matching outer nodes are appended at array+16 with a 24-byte stride. The second list appends entries after the first-list run without updating the entry counter. Always returns 0. Called by VertexBufferResourceAllocation (0x00543FA0).

operations.description: Initialize the entry counter v2 to 0 before any rebuild work.
Skip the entire rebuild when the entry count this+0x13C is not positive.
When an old array exists at this+0x140, walk it backward in 24-byte steps, invoking EmptyStub_0170 for each of the recorded elements (count read from the 4-byte header at array-4).
Free the old array allocation through its 4-byte header pointer (array-4) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Allocate new storage of 24 * this+0x13C + 4 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper.
Write the element count into the 4-byte allocation header; the array payload begins at header+4.
Initialize each 24-byte element of the new array with ShortComputation_8e00, advancing 6 dwords (24 bytes) per element until the count is exhausted.
Store the new array payload pointer at this+0x140 (this[80] = v12).
Walk the first node list from head this+0x100, following the forward link at +0x104 (v14 = *(v14 + 260)) until null.
Skip a first-list node when its byte flag at +0x4 has bit 0x40 set.
Read the sub-list head v15 from the node at +0xEC (v15 = *(v14 + 236)).
Iterate the sub-list v15 via its next pointer at +0x4C (v15 = *(v15 + 76)) until null.
Read the chain start v17 from the sub-list node at +0x204 (v17 = *(v15 + 516)).
Follow the chain forward link at +0x10 (v17 = *(v17 + 16)) until a node whose flags at +0x14 include 0x4000, or the chain ends.
Append a matched first-list sub-node pointer into slot array+16+24*v2, advance the entry counter v2 and the 24-byte slot stride.
Walk the second node list from head this+0x108, iterating nodes by their next pointer at +0x4C; per node, descend the same node layout (+0x204 sub-chain, +0x10/+0x14 chain links/flags).
Append matched second-list nodes into slots after the first-list run with a 24-byte stride, without updating the entry counter v2.
